A [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was a member of a [[Currency/Legends|wealthy]] and powerful [[Pekt's clan|clan]] on their [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. Prior to the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Trandoshan [[Reproduction/Legends|sired]] a son, [[Pekt]], who worked to expand the clan's empire as a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] and used his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] fortune to research the biology of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], a species from the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] who were the ancient enemies of the Trandoshans. Pekt's father was also the grandfather to Pekt's own [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-litter.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pekt's father was mentioned in Pekt's DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
